privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: [Current Date]

1. Introduction

Welcome to WagerX. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you in Nigeria.

2. Data We Collect

We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, including:

  • Identity Data: Full name, username, date of birth
  • Contact Data: Email address, phone number
  • Financial Data: Payment details, wagering history
  • Technical Data: IP address, login data, browser type and version

3. How We Use Your Data

We use your personal data to:

  • Provide and manage your account
  • Process your wagers and payments
  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
  • Improve our services and marketing

4. Data Security

We have implemented appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorized way. We limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors, and other third parties who have a business need to know.

5. Your Legal Rights

Under Nigerian data protection laws, you have rights in relation to your personal data, including the right to request access, correction, erasure, restriction, transfer, or to object to processing.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@wagerx.ng.

termsOfUsage.title: Terms of Usage
termsOfUsage.content:
Terms of Usage

Last updated: [Current Date]

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using WagerX, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. Additionally, when using this website's particular services, you shall be subject to any posted guidelines or rules applicable to such services.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and a resident of Nigeria to use our services. By using WagerX, you represent and warrant that you meet these eligibility requirements.

3. Account Registration

To use our services, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and to update such information to keep it accurate, current, and complete.

4. Wagering Rules

All wagers are subject to our posted rules and regulations. We reserve the right to refuse any wager or to close any account at our sole discretion.

5. Deposits and Withdrawals

We offer various methods for depositing and withdrawing funds. All transactions are subject to review for security and compliance purposes.

6. Responsible Gaming

We are committed to responsible gaming and provide tools to help you manage your wagering activity. If you feel you may have a gambling problem, please contact the National Lottery Regulatory Commission for assistance.

7. Intellectual Property

The content, organization, graphics, design, compilation, and other matters related to the Site are protected under applicable copyrights, trademarks, and other proprietary rights.

8. Limitation of Liability

WagerX shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.

9. Governing Law

These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

license.title: License Information
license.content:
License Information

WagerX is licensed and regulated by the National Lottery Regulatory Commission (NLRC) of Nigeria.

License Details

License Number: NLRC/WG/0123/2024

Issued Date: January 1, 2024

Valid Until: December 31, 2024

Regulatory Compliance

WagerX operates in full compliance with the National Lottery Act, 2005 and all subsequent regulations set forth by the NLRC. We are committed to:

  • Providing fair and transparent wagering services
  • Implementing strict age verification processes
  • Promoting responsible gaming practices
  • Ensuring the security and integrity of all transactions
  • Protecting user data and privacy

Verification

To verify our license status, please visit the official NLRC website at https://nlrc.gov.ng and use our license number for reference.

Complaints and Dispute Resolution

If you have any complaints or disputes that cannot be resolved directly with WagerX, you may contact the NLRC at:

National Lottery Regulatory Commission
No. 605, Zambezi Crescent,
Off Aguiyi Ironsi Street, Maitama, Abuja.
Email: info@nlrc.gov.ng
Phone: +234 (0) 9- 291 9200

Commitment to Compliance

WagerX is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance and ethical business practices. We regularly undergo audits and assessments to ensure our continued adherence to all applicable laws and regulations.

bonusPolicy.title: Bonus Policy
bonusPolicy.content:
Bonus Policy

Last updated: [Current Date]

1. Introduction

At WagerX, we offer various bonuses to enhance your gaming experience. This policy outlines the terms and conditions associated with our bonus offerings.

2. Types of Bonuses

  • Welcome Bonus: Available to new users upon first deposit
  • Reload Bonus: Offered on subsequent deposits
  • Referral Bonus: Rewarded for referring new users
  • Loyalty Bonus: Based on your playing activity

3. General Terms

  • Bonuses are subject to wagering requirements before withdrawal
  • Only one bonus can be active at a time
  • WagerX reserves the right to modify or cancel any bonus at any time
  • Bonuses are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash

4. Wagering Requirements

Unless stated otherwise, all bonuses are subject to a 20x wagering requirement. This means you must wager the bonus amount 20 times before you can withdraw any winnings associated with the bonus.

5. Game Contributions

Different games contribute differently to the wagering requirements:

  • Slots: 100%
  • Table Games: 20%
  • Live Casino: 10%

6. Time Limits

Bonuses expire after 30 days unless stated otherwise. Any unused bonus or associated winnings will be forfeited after this period.

7. Maximum Bet

When playing with an active bonus, the maximum allowed bet is ₦5,000 per spin or hand.

8. Abuse and Fraud Prevention

WagerX reserves the right to withhold bonuses and associated winnings if we suspect any form of bonus abuse or fraudulent activity.

9. Responsible Gaming

We encourage responsible gaming. Bonuses should enhance your entertainment, not be seen as a way to make money. If you feel you may have a gambling problem, please contact our support team for assistance.

10. Changes to This Policy

WagerX may update this Bonus Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Bonus Policy on this page.

about.title: About WagerX
about.content:
About WagerX

Our Story

Founded in 2024, WagerX is Nigeria's premier online wagering platform, bringing the excitement of sports betting and casino games to your fingertips. Born out of a passion for technology and a love for sports, WagerX aims to revolutionize the online gaming experience for Nigerians.

Our Mission

At WagerX, our mission is to provide a safe, fair, and thrilling wagering environment that caters to the unique preferences of Nigerian gamers. We strive to combine cutting-edge technology with local insights to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.

What Sets Us Apart

  • Local Focus: Tailored specifically for the Nigerian market, offering popular local and international sports events.
  • Innovative Technology: State-of-the-art platform ensuring smooth, fast, and secure gaming experiences.
  • Responsible Gaming: Committed to promoting responsible gambling practices with tools to help users manage their gaming habits.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: 24/7 customer support in multiple Nigerian languages.
  • Diverse Gaming Options: From sports betting to virtual games and casino classics.

Our Team

WagerX is powered by a diverse team of Nigerian tech enthusiasts, sports fanatics, and gaming experts. Our leadership brings years of experience in the tech and gaming industries, ensuring we stay at the forefront of innovation.

Community Engagement

We believe in giving back to the community. WagerX is actively involved in various corporate social responsibility initiatives, focusing on sports development and tech education in Nigeria.

Regulatory Compliance

WagerX is fully licensed and regulated by the National Lottery Regulatory Commission (NLRC) of Nigeria. We adhere strictly to all local laws and regulations, ensuring a safe and legal gaming environment for all our users.

Looking Ahead

As we continue to grow, our focus remains on innovation, user satisfaction, and responsible gaming. We're excited about the future of online wagering in Nigeria and are committed to leading the way in this dynamic industry.

Join Us

Experience the thrill of wagering with a platform that truly understands you. Join WagerX today and be part of the future of online gaming in Nigeria!
